verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way to define event-triggered rules that run actions automatically. The closest item is a help-index mention of "定时任务" (scheduled tasks), which is a time-based schedule rather than event-driven rule automation, so it is adjacent and earns no credit. Other items cover conversational agent tasks that the user starts by hand. The axis applies to an AI assistant or agent product, so missing evidence means "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
